policy: This is a conservative candidate whitelist of provider networks based on public vendor references. A network pair is emitted ONLY if the catalog already contains a specific EVM JSON-RPC offer from the same provider on that exact chain. This does not prove archive or enterprise contract availability. Missing evidence MUST NOT be inferred as support.
